function: Learns joint LEO satellite selection and terminal transmit-power trade-off weights for distributed collaborative beamforming uplink, balancing rate, energy, and switching count (p. 7).
system: 10 terminals form a virtual antenna array uplinking to one of 110 LEO satellites; LoS channel with random phases; 2.4 GHz; no RIS (pp. 4, 10).
method: Evolutionary multi-objective deep reinforcement learning with dueling DQN agents (EMODRL-ED3QN), 10 tasks, two 2048-neuron layers, tanh, legitimate-action masking in epsilon-greedy exploration (pp. 8, 10).
data_channel: Custom simulator only: LoS path loss with random phase, exponent 2; 110 circular-orbit LEO satellites with Bernoulli availability; no public dataset or measurement (pp. 4, 5, 10).
test_conditions: Default scenario: 10 terminals, 60-minute timeline (p. 10); the trained policies are then evaluated with 8-12 terminals and unavailability probability 0-0.2 (Fig. 6, p. 12).
baselines: Non-learned: single-terminal non-DCB and achievable-rate greedy policy (ARGP). Learned: EMODRL variants of D3QN, Noisy-DQN, DDQN, PPO, TD3, SAC; ablations OOP, OLASM (pp. 10, 12).
metrics: Average total uplink achievable rate (bps), total terminal energy (J), satellite switching frequency; Pareto policy distributions (Table I, Figs. 4-8, pp. 11-12).
complexity: Time complexity orders only: training O(Tevo n Titer Nepo Ndata sum N(l-1)N(l)), inference O(T sum N(c-1)N(c)); no measured runtime or FLOPs (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "channel model incorporating LoS path loss alongside random"; custom LoS simulator, no 3GPP TR 38.901/38.811/38.821 model, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "one-time training can accommodate various terminal numbers"; Fig. 6(b) varies terminals 8-12 around the default 10 on the trained policies.
q3_support: p. 10: "Achievable rate greedy policy (ARGP)"; "EMODRL-SAC as the baseline algorithms"; non-learned ARGP and non-DCB, learned DDQN, Noisy-DQN, PPO, TD3, SAC inside the EMODRL framework.
q4_support: p. 10: "we analyze the time complexity of using"; O() orders for training and inference are given, no measured runtime.
q5_support: p. 10: "we set up 110 periodically operated LEO satellites"; simulated scenario, no code or data link, no public dataset.
notes: Area 6: the learned action a_t = {k_t, s_t} (p. 7) selects the satellite (above PHY, handover) and a power trade-off index (PHY power control for DCB; powers then come from convex P2, pp. 6-7), so the joint rule of above_phy passes; DCB phases are set analytically. The paper does not state the antenna count per terminal; each terminal acts as one array element. q2 rests on Fig. 6 (viewed on the page image: terminals 8-12, p from 0 to 0.2) and the claim of one-time training; the training terminal count is not stated beyond the default 10. q3: the learned baselines are standard DRL algorithms placed inside the proposed EMODRL framework, which the reviewer may judge as variants of the proposed method. The PDF is the arXiv preprint 2404.07450v1 with the title of the JSAC paper; the DOI is not printed in it.
